description: This file contains TypeScript code implementing client-side functions for Signal RPC communication, including request handling, server status checking, and server-sent events streaming, with external dependencies on openclaw plugin SDK modules.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a base URL by trimming, ensuring protocol, and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: getRequiredFetch
methods.description: Resolves and returns the fetch implementation, throwing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: parseSignalRpcResponse
methods.description: Parses and validates JSON RPC response text, ensuring correct structure and presence of result or error.

methods.name: signalRpcRequest
methods.description: Performs a JSON RPC request to the server with method and parameters, returning the result or throwing on error.

methods.name: signalCheck
methods.description: Checks server availability and status via a GET request, returning success or error info.

methods.name: streamSignalEvents
methods.description: Establishes a server-sent events stream, processing incoming events and invoking callback.
